versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g Service Name Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown (draft) Syntax void Nm_ForwardSynchronizedPncShutdown ( void ) Service ID [hex] 0x23 Sync/Async Synchronous Reentrancy Non Reentrant -reentrant for the same NetworkHandle, reentrant otherwise Parameters (in) None Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Notification that the network management has received a PN shutdown message on a particular NM-channel. This is used to grant a nearly synchronized PNC shutdown across the entire PN topology. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Nm.h
